title: Simulation 3D Three Wheeled Vehicle
text: 在 3D 环境中实现三轮车辆，输入 3 路；{Type} 指定车辆类型 Tuk、{Name} 指定车辆名称 SimulinkVehicle1、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} 指定车辆初始平移 zeros、{Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} 指定车辆初始旋转 zeros、{Enable light controls} 控制车辆车灯、{Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor} 指定前照灯颜色、{High beam intensity, HighBeamIntensity} 指定远光强度、{Low beam intensity, LowBeamIntensity} 指定近光强度、{High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle} 指定远光锥半角、{Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle} 指定近光锥半角、{Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation} 指定左前照灯光束方向、{Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation} 指定右前照灯光束方向、{Brake light intensity, BrakelightIntensity} 指定制动灯强度、{Reverse light intensity, ReverselightIntensity} 指定倒车灯强度、{Turn signal light intensity, SignallightIntensity} 指定转向信号灯强度、{Period, SignallightPeriod} 指定转向信号灯周期、{Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth} 指定脉冲宽度，按实例取值。

params.name: Name
params.values: 车辆名称 SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
params.values: 车辆初始平移 zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | 5-by-3 array

params.name: Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
params.values: 车辆初始旋转 zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | 5-by-3 array

params.name: Enable light controls
params.values: 控制车辆车灯的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor
params.values: 前照灯颜色 [1,1,1] (default) | 1-by-3 vector of RGB triplet values

params.name: High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle
params.values: 远光锥半角 1.22 (default) | positive scalar less than pi/2

params.name: Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle
params.values: 近光锥半角 1.22 (default) | positive scalar less than pi/2

params.name: Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation
params.values: 左前照灯光束方向 [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 vector with values between -pi and pi

params.name: Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation
params.values: 右前照灯光束方向 [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 vector with values between -pi and pi

params.name: Turn signal light intensity, SignallightIntensity
params.values: 转向信号灯强度 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Period, SignallightPeriod
params.values: 转向信号灯周期 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth
params.values: 脉冲宽度 50 (default) | positive scalar less than 100
